sections.text: Vendor Z may receive Dataset Z only. Vendor Z is not authorized to receive Dataset Y or Dataset W under standard conditions.
The Finance department may authorize Vendor Z to receive Dataset W for quarterly reporting purposes, subject to CFO written approval.

Finance department requests for Vendor Z Dataset W access must be submitted via the Vendor Exception Portal (Form VEP-FIN-01) with CFO sign-off. Approved access is limited to the reporting period (maximum 30 days).
